prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning beds or spray (sunless) tans? Also: which part of Columbus (zip code or neighborhood) and what matters most to you — price, fastest results, natural look, cleanliness, or technician skill? If you tell me that I can look up and recommend the top salons near you.

Meanwhile, quick guidance so you can pick the best salon:

What to prefer
- For safety and consistent results choose spray/sunless tanning (good brands: Norvell, Versa, Mystic). UV beds increase skin‑cancer risk.
- If you want a UV bed, go to a salon that keeps equipment well maintained and staff who explain skin typing and exposure limits.

How to pick the best salon
- Reviews and ratings: look for many recent 4+ star reviews on Google/Yelp/Facebook.
- Photos & before/after: check clients’ pictures to judge outcome.
- Cleanliness: beds, booths, and prep areas should look sanitized; employees should use gloves and fresh applicators.
- Technician training: ask whether spray techs are certified and what solutions they use.
- Product quality: reputable spray brands and organic or DHA options.
- Patch test: a good salon offers a small patch test for new clients for allergies and color preview.
- Price transparency & loyalty options: clear pricing, package deals, and expiration policies.

Questions to ask when calling
- Which spray system and solution brand do you use?
- Are your technicians certified? Can I see before/after photos?
- Do you offer patch tests or consultations?
- How do you sanitize booths/beds between clients?
- What is the wait time/rebooking policy if I need a touch-up?

If you tell me your neighborhood or ZIP code and whether you want spray or UV, I’ll find the top-rated salons in Columbus and list 3–5 with pros/cons and contact info.
